leadText:
Christie (Japanese: リナ Rina) is a Pokémon Trainer and a character of the day who appeared in Where Did You Go, Audino?. 

Christie helped Officer Jenny investigate the disappearances after another Audino, with whom she was good friends, disappeared. She and Doyle would often argue on who would find the missing Audino first and would compete with one another using their Pokémon. She also had a hunch that the Audino were being manipulated by some sort of Psychic attack.

Christie would later be partnered up with to watch after 's Audino, on which they had put a tracking device. The Audino soon started acting strange, so Christie and Iris began following it, only to meet up with Officer Jenny, , Doyle, and again. Christie managed to slow one down with 's .

Christie and the others soon found all of the missing Audino and discovered that they were being controlled by sound waves created by . She used Gothita to battle Jessie's Woobat. After the case was solved, Christie was eager to know if her Gothita helped out more than Doyle's . However, Officer Jenny informed the both of them that Ash's Roggenrola helped out the most, leaving them both disappointed.
